newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed amid light volumes.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed amid light volumes.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled mixed after a thinly traded session in which the market appeared to shrug off concerns about further snowfall in the northern U.S. Plains, traders said.
"We felt a little support there at the end... but I don't think it's from the snow," a MGE floor source said. "People have already been working that angle for some time."
Traders noted some early hedge-related selling in nearby MGE May spring wheat, and some light mill-related buying by ADM and Atwood-Peavey in deferred September and July contracts.

MGE spring wheat was also dogged early by spillover pressure from CBOT soybeans, which sagged on bearish technicals and improved planting prospects amid forecasts for warm, dry weather in the U.S. Midwest.
MGE spring wheat settled 2-1/4 cents lower to 1/4 cent higher, with May down 2-1/4 cents at $4.04. July was up 1/4 cent at $3.92-3/4, and Sept lost one cent to close at $3.91.
MGE barley futures did not trade.
